item.title: The Web Can't Afford a JavaScript Runtime Monoculture
item.description: Earlier this month Deno announced its whole team is joining Cloudflare. In the announcement, Ryan Dahl, who created Node.js and started Deno in 2018, also explains that development of the Deno runtime will stop after one year. (3 sources: javascriptweekly, lobsters, nodeweekly)

item.title: Vitest 5: Prioritises Performance with a Shared Vite Server, Trace View, and Stricter Test Defaults
item.description: Vitest 5.0 focuses on speed, with reported gains of 8 to 25 percent in most setups and up to 53 percent in VM pools. It adds a vitest doctor command, Browser Mode Trace View, and vi.when. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Game Off 2026: The theme is SHIFT
item.description: GitHub’s annual month-long game jam is back for its 14th year! This November, make a game inspired by the theme SHIFT. Change gears, swap perspectives, bend reality, or just press a certain key. (2 sources: githubblog, javascriptweekly)
